title: Interviewer asks about Arodin, Cordillo and Troy Floyd
summary: The interviewer asks about Sidney Arodin, a Texas band with Jack Teagarden, and Troy Floyd; Manno knows none of them.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
